title: [DocDB] race condition between master Shutdown and GetTransactionStatus call
body:
Jira Link: [DB-6450](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-6450)
### Description

```
[m-1] W0421 06:18:36.662953 677836 catalog_manager_bg_tasks.cc:165] Catalog manager background task thread going to sleep: Service unavailable (yb/master/scoped_leader_shared_lock.cc:92): Catalog manager is not initialized. State: 3
[m-1] W0421 06:18:36.676033 678092 ysql_transaction_ddl.cc:178] Shutting down. Cannot get GetTransactionStatus: { transaction_id: cc6c2a75-2551-45b2-ab58-3d23a5bf581b isolation: SNAPSHOT_ISOLATION status_tablet: {transactions_tablet_id1} priority: 9830443320244263716 start_time: { days: 19468 time: 06:17:35.028368 } locality: GLOBAL old_status_tablet:  external_transaction: 0}
*** Aborted at 1682057916 (unix time) try "date -d @1682057916" if you are using GNU date ***
[m-1] W0421 06:18:36.676283 677806 thread.cc:680] Waited for 1.000s trying to join with rpc_tp_Master_2 (tid 677855)
PC: @                0x0 (unknown)
*** SIGSEGV (@0x0) received by PID 677806 (TID 0x7f11a9065700) from PID 0; stack trace: ***
    @     0x7f11c638a76e yb::client::(anonymous namespace)::TransactionRpcBase::TransactionRpcBase()
    @     0x7f11c638b577 yb::client::GetTransactionStatus()
    @     0x7f11c7639553 yb::tablet::RunningTransaction::SendStatusRequest()
    @     0x7f11c7638cc1 yb::tablet::RunningTransaction::RequestStatusAt()
    @     0x7f11c76e0312 yb::tablet::TransactionParticipant::MinRunningHybridTime()
    @     0x7f11c72af206 yb::docdb::IntentAwareIterator::IntentAwareIterator()
    @     0x7f11c727de28 yb::docdb::CreateIntentAwareIterator()
    @     0x7f11c729d336 yb::docdb::DocRowwiseIterator::InitIterator()
    @     0x7f11c729a182 yb::docdb::DocRowwiseIteratorBase::Init()
    @     0x7f11c8379b22 yb::master::SysCatalogTable::ReadYsqlDBCatalogVersionImpl()
    @     0x7f11c837a819 yb::master::SysCatalogTable::ReadYsqlDBCatalogVersion()
    @     0x7f11c816f9d6 yb::master::CatalogManager::GetYsqlDBCatalogVersion()
    @     0x7f11c816f75d yb::master::CatalogManager::GetYsqlCatalogVersion()
    @     0x7f11c82e7e94 yb::master::(anonymous namespace)::MasterHeartbeatServiceImpl::TSHeartbeat()
    @     0x7f11c5ac6ff0 std::__function::__func<>::operator()()
    @     0x7f11c5ac760f yb::master::MasterHeartbeatIf::Handle()
    @     0x7f11c4820146 yb::rpc::ServicePoolImpl::Handle()
    @     0x7f11c47c7a7f yb::rpc::InboundCall::InboundCallTask::Run()
    @     0x7f11c482c81f yb::rpc::(anonymous namespace)::Worker::Execute()
    @     0x7f11c465348c yb::Thread::SuperviseThread()
    @     0x7f11c2f07694 start_thread
    @     0x7f11c2c4941d __clone
```

RunningTransaction::SendStatusRequest() should handle the case where client_future is nullptr. e.g.
```
  auto client = context_.participant_context_.client_future().get();
  if (!client) {
    LOG(WARNING) << "Shutting down. Cannot get GetTransactionStatus: " << metadata_;
    return;
  }
```
